reviews.text: Great service great prices

My fur baby passed away Monday😭 after taking her to this place to get her vaccines on the 18th of April ! Their negligence left my baby paralyzed from her back legs not able to walk pie or poop on her own she was in pain and all because the stupid vaccines.I took her in on the 20th Monday to get an explanation or help because when I took her she was perfectly healthy and happy. All I was told aside of all the things I mentioned that could have caused her to be like that such as injecting her the wrong way hurting something on her legs nerves or bones was that she probably ended like that because of rough play or a disc problem which makes no sense because if that were to be the case wouldn’t she have not passed the check up before the vaccines? I felt stupid even going back to that place to see what could help to make her feel better because the medication did nothing to help and neither did they. But I was upset and felt like they needed to take action and responsibility to their mistakes but they Just washed their hands as if it was my fault and kept saying they have never experienced such thing yet I have evidence my dog was fine for the past months, and days before the appointment and the day of the appointment up until she came out of there the problems started. Pls don’t take ur dogs here!!! My poodle girl was just 1yr and 10 months old. That was my soul mate😭 and now she’s gone because of a mistake they did on her vaccine visit. Because of their mistake i spent my baby’s last days with us back in and out of other dog hospitals and vets trying to help her get better.

Update: the manger did reach out and was very apologetic. She did admit that it was a big mistake that should have never happened and that they as a team should have never let happen. She did say they had a meeting in regards to making sure that this never happens again and even if things get hectic nothing should be forgotten. I appreciate them admitting their fault and for being truly sorry. You could tell how sincere she was. They did refund me the money that I spent there which was very nice. I can't get my cat back but having someone admit their mistake and being very sorry for it feels a tiny bit better.

The worst vet! Please do not take your animal here. Brought my cat in last friday. Was told she has an infection probably in her mouth due to a tooth. Paid to get a blood panel done. The vet said she would give my cat antibiotics and pain meds before going home. She had to have a mild sedation to get the blood draw. Upon taking her hime Saturday she got worse. Tried multiple times to talk to the vet. Was always sent to voicemail. Finally monday late afternoon the receptionist called me back saying the panel wasnt back yet. I mentioned my cat getting worse and how I dont think antibiotics were given. Still never heard from a vet. After putting my cat down I hear from the vet via text that the panel came back with inflammation and mild calcium. Turns out they never gave her the antibiotics. So horrible. My baby could have been saved if they only they did their job.
Thank you!

We found kittens in our backyard that were hours old. The kittens were stuck together by placenta or umbilical cord and didn’t know what to do. We called Abbott and was told not to bring them there. Abbot was absolutely heartless. They have the resources to save them and we don’t. Don’t take your animals their

My French Bulldogs are seen at this facility. Nothing but positive comments. The provider and staff are always so knowledgeable and warm. My dogs were spayed at this facility at an affordable price with great care.
Really good and speedy service at an economical price.

I am so happy with this place! I was sceptical at first, but the vets and care that they provided was outstanding! I took my cat several times there. And I will continue, even though they are an hour away from me. They provided detailed information on why my kitty had troubles urinating. The cost was most affordable than any other clinic.
Dr. Child is wonderful—knowledgeable, kind, and responsive. She takes time to thoroughly examine your pet and is great about working with your schedule.
Thank you so much! 🥰 …
Do not bring if you have a cat! Unprofessional and untrained staff. Would not recommend to any cat owners or ever bring my cat back

Worst experience ever I went to take my cat and a staff named Alex who came up to me and not to be rude but he was not hygienic and had a smell to him that almost made me throw up and another staff came up to me Mario  was very inappropriate and saying my dress looked fitted on me and looked at my Breast and asked me on a date very unprofessional and the smell of weed was insane and as I was going to the back room and saw the same men smoking so disgusting do not take your pet there

0/5 stars if possible. I called to get a price on a physical for my kitty who has been feeling skittish. The woman answering the call mumbled a whole lot of nothing and mumbled forty- something dollars, “does that do it for you?” what a pathetic way to answer a possible client. I called because the reviews seemed promising but I guess I’ll take my kitty elsewhere.
Dr Childs is a very caring and thorough professional.
They never answer the phone and then don't respond to voice mails. Not great.

I called before the clinic opened, leaving a message that explained my cat's symptoms and what they advised.  I was offered an appointment for the afternoon the next day(today). It turns out these symptoms can be fatal, and my cat was in serious condition.  He had to be rushed by my husband to an emergency veterinary clinic, as Abbott could not treat him beyond the examination/diagnosis.  He just got out of surgery at the emergency clinic, and at the time of this post, we are still hoping he pulls through.

When I called asking why we were not told we should consider emergency care given the symptoms I described, I was told by the office staff it's my responsibility to know what is an emergency and that it's not their responsibility. I was also told to "focus on your cat and not insignificant arguments",  and "you're  ridiculous". I was refused access to speaking to an office manager or anyone else, and then hung up on.
I sent an email and a text; thus far there has been no response.

When a pet could be dying, people deserve compassion.  Never again will I take any animal to that clinic. I have had pets my whole life, and I have never experienced anything like this at any vet. My husband said Dr. Childs was somewhat kind during the examination, but she and her staff were overall dismissive.  Her staff needs serious training, and the level of unprofessionalism was astounding. Nobody deserves to be treated like that.
Staff could be better communicating but the veterinarian herself has been definitely worth it. She's great

We brought our 3 cats here for over 5 years. One of our cats was severely sick so we called over and over again and left many voicemails waiting for a call back. Not once did they respond to any of my voicemails about our cat. We ended up taking our cat to Route 66 animal hospital. Our cat got the help he needed and were able to save him. Not once did this clinic ever reach out to us. Never replied. So that’s how we know that after 5 years of us being loyal to them that they actually don’t care.
The wait was a little long but the tech and Dr were very thorough in checking out our new puppy.
Excellent service
